title: tx_queue/main.c: ASSERT_EQ macro double-evaluates on failure
description:
Lines 33-38: When assertion fails, the first argument is evaluated twice (once for comparison, once for printf). For side-effectful expressions like tx_queue_pop(), this could call the function twice and print a different value than what was compared.
